seed: The reworked selection at Next defaults with no flag changed (the user's approved prototype selection-transform.html, 2026-11-01). A rectangle is drawn on a blank picture and picked: white corner squares, a pill just outside each edge, a knob with a clockwise arrow on a dotted stem, the Size and 3D chip beside it, and its size in a tag under it. Each grip lights alone under the resting pointer and the tag says what it does. A corner keeps the proportions, Shift stretches, an edge pill stretches one way, Option grows it from the middle, and a double press on the knob turns it back to 0 degrees. The chip switches to 3D: an edge pill tips and swings the card, Shift steps the turn by 15 degrees, the grip below pushes it back and pulls it forward, one undo step each, and the grips stay one size on the turned card. Escape steps back to Size with the turn kept. Then a 140 by 45 button: every grip, the knob and the chip have their own target, measured, in Size and in 3D.

steps.note: a picked rectangle wears the reworked selection: white corner squares, an edge pill outside each side, the knob with its arrow on a dotted stem, the Size and 3D chip beside it, and 300 × 210 in a tag under it
a corner kept the proportions (360 × 252), Shift stretched it back, the right pill stretched one way to 340, and Option grew it from the middle to 380 with the left side moving out by as much
the knob turned the card, and a double press on it turned it back to 0 degrees: the tag reads only the size again

in 3D the right pill tipped and swung the card at once, Shift stepped the next swing to 60, the grip below pushed it back 100 and pulled it forward 100, and one undo put the forward pull back: the grips are the same size on the turned card
Escape stepped back to Size and the card kept its turn; back in 3D the tag reads the same turn and depth
